binding: V36 state-directional bfde0d8; census 548; Kalshi fee = ceil(0.07*p*(100-p)/100) cents/contract per fill.

part1_three_rulers.headline_mapping: 104/362/680 -> map to the ruler totals below at <100; (a) close-anchored, (b) floor-sum, (c) near-miss/offer

part3_money.fee_note: Kalshi trading fee ceil(0.07*p*(1-p)) per contract; maker/resting fills exempt (net_taker applies fee to TAKER legs only). At a median 1c pair margin a single taker fee (~2c) exceeds gross -> net negative.

part5_verification_spec.measure: At each armed standing level, count (i) FILLS (a seller-aggressed print actually swept our resting bid) vs (ii) NEAR-MISSES (a seller-aggressed print landed 1-3c above the rest but did not sweep to us). Conversion rate = fills/(fills+near-misses).
part5_verification_spec.census_assumes: the 1c-residency conversion assumes ~100% of 1c near-misses convert to fills.
part5_verification_spec.kill_number: If observed conversion rate < break-even = fees/gross_margin per assumed pair. With median assumed margin ~1c and a ~2c taker fee, break-even conversion is undefined (negative) -- i.e. ANY positive conversion still loses after fees; the census book is refuted at first fee-bearing fill. On a gross basis the kill number is conversion < 50% (below which even gross assumed value halves under the 680 offer).
part5_verification_spec.read_law: per category, require >=30 completed test games and >=200 armed levels before ruling; refute if measured fill/(fill+near-miss) < kill_number.
